name: Crypto online-work scam patterns (observed)
source: First-hand evaluation of ~160 crypto work venues, Oct 25 - Nov 6 2026. Companion to crypto-work-census-nov-2026.md
rule_of_thumb: If money has to move from you before it moves to you, walk away.

patterns.name: Vague remote job, large XMR pay
signals: 'ongoing remote work' with no task described
asks for device or account access

patterns.name: Pay to unlock / stake to claim
signals: deposit or stake required before a task
recurring task series with 0 completions ever

patterns.name: Referral or shill farming dressed as a bounty
signals: pay per referral or per signup

patterns.name: Move to private contact
signals: job post asks you to email a free webmail address

patterns.name: Nominee identity or key harvesting
signals: asks you to be the 'front' name on a listing or account
marketplace asks for a wallet private view key at signup

patterns.name: Pirated goods sold as digital products
signals: brand-name content at a fraction of retail

patterns.name: Auto-generated 'escrow bounty' GitHub issues
signals: many new repos posting '$250 escrow' bounty issues
link to an outside escrow site to 'claim'
no real codebase behind the issue
patterns.seen_on: GitHub issue search for USDC bounties
